sections.what_happened: [VERIFIED FACT -- visit + agenda, carried] Zelenskyy pays a working visit to Turkiye Oct 31 at Erdogan's invitation; Istanbul talks cover bilateral cooperation, the Russia-Ukraine war and Black Sea security, followed by a news conference. [VERIFIED FACT -- window check] No meeting outcome, joint statement, or news-conference readout was published in the 07:00-08:00 window (03:00-04:00 UTC). [STALE TRAP -- DO NOT USE] The Gaze article 'Zelenskyy and Erdogan Strengthen Cooperation in Security and Energy' (crawled in-window, no date shown) reproduces the APRIL 4, 2026 Istanbul meeting: its quote ('fundamental political willingness... teams will finalize the details in the coming days'), gas-infrastructure and gas-field items, and Telegram sourcing match verbatim the Straits Times/Reuters April 4 report and UNN's April 6 follow-up ('the day before yesterday in Istanbul'). It is NOT the Oct 31 outcome. Any production using it as today's outcome would be reporting a 7-month-old meeting as news.
sections.what_verified: Visit/announcement: Turkish presidency + Reuters (prior records). No-outcome finding: window sweep returned only Oct 30 announcements/recaps plus the April stale article.
sections.what_disputed: None on the visit itself; the risk is purely the stale-article trap identified above.
